summary: Tested Landing CMS admin flow end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 pytest passed (public GET, unauth PUT rejected, admin/nonadmin is_admin flag, admin text/cards/marquee updates, unknown text keys ignored, persistence). Frontend: admin login → hover edit/delete on 4 niche cards, card-edit + save + reload persistence, card-delete + confirm + card-add restore, marquee editor (rename/remove/add/save), click-to-edit hero headline (text-hero-caption-title) → save on Enter + reload persistence. Visitor (cookies cleared): no admin controls rendered, headlines not contentEditable, DB values shown. State restored to defaults (4 cards, original ticker, 'B2B Success Analytics').

ui_bugs.issue: Missing `import { toast } from 'sonner'` in /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx. saveCard/deleteCard/saveMarquee call toast.success/toast.error but toast was not imported → ReferenceError on every card/marquee save. Fixed by testing agent (added import).

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription for a11y (non-blocking).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to CardEditor and MarqueeEditor DialogContent for a11y.
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx used toast without importing it → runtime ReferenceError on every admin save. Testing agent added the import; main agent should keep it and consider ESLint rule 'no-undef' to catch this.
landing_cms.py: unknown text keys are silently dropped (spec compliant). Trim + length caps applied appropriately (80/300/500/200/40).
PUT /admin/landing uses `is_admin` check via env ADMIN_EMAIL comparison — solid but consider a role flag for future multi-admin support.
seed_data_creation: Created one throwaway non-admin user TEST_nonadmin_<ts>@example.com to verify is_admin=false and 403 on PUT /admin/landing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing CMS is fully functional. State was restored to defaults at end: 4 default cards (E-commerce, SaaS dashboards, Wellness apps, Logistics tools), marquee (Nexus, Orbit, Fleet, Aura, Ledger, Studio, Vanta, Halo), hero_caption_title 'B2B Success Analytics'. Regression test file: /app/backend/tests/test_landing_cms.py.
rca of the issue: Landing.jsx bug: `toast` used in three handlers (saveCard, deleteCard, saveMarquee) but not imported. Reproduction: admin login → click card-edit-btn → save → ReferenceError in console after successful API call, toast never shown. Mitigation applied: added `import { toast } from 'sonner';` at top of /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.jsx.
